svg.aria-label: What others say — Nikita Blinkov, Head of People & Org Dev @ Glam AI · worked together at Glam.ai: “I had the pleasure of working with Anastasia and can confidently say she is an exceptional AI specialist with a rare combination of technical depth, versatility, and strong ownership. … Overall, she is someone who doesn't just understand AI, but knows how to apply it in a way that brings real value, while also supporting and elevating the people around her.”; Paul Miller, Luxury High Jewellery & Timepiece Retoucher · client: “Both highly professional and innovative, each project has felt more like a genuine collaboration.”
